# ARWP Growth Loop

Canonical: https://dkharlanau.github.io/agent-ready-web-profile/growth/
Status: experimental evidence-backed product layer, reviewed 2026-09-06

Goal:
Continuously improve Search eligibility, recommendation readiness, citability and agent usability by turning current primary-source research into explicit hypotheses, implementation checks and measurable follow-up evidence.

Loop:
research -> classify -> baseline -> hypothesis -> implement -> verify -> measure -> keep/revise/revert

Layers:
- Trend Radar: WATCH / ADOPT / MEASURED upstream changes plus owner-only platform controls.
- Recommendations Registry: dated requirements/opportunities.
- Growth Hypotheses: applicability, evidence class, checks and success signals.
- Growth Profile: prioritized site-specific implementation backlog.
- Agent Skills: repository execution and verification.
- Measurement: owner-side outcomes kept separate from implementation proof.

Run:
node bin/arwp-trends.mjs list --since=90 --exclude-retired
node bin/arwp-hypotheses.mjs list --vertical=editorial
node bin/arwp-growth.mjs https://example.com --vertical=editorial --json

Default growth skill:
arwp-growth-loop
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dkharlanau/agent-ready-web-profile/main/skills/arwp-growth-loop/SKILL.md

Machine hypotheses:
https://dkharlanau.github.io/agent-ready-web-profile/growth/hypotheses.json

Boundaries:
- no universal quality/readiness score;
- no ranking / Discover / AI recommendation guarantee;
- requirements before experiments;
- manual quality stays manual;
- authenticated owner controls and owner metrics stay external-owner-data;
- agent interoperability metadata is not a Google ranking signal;
- preserve neutral and negative results.
